_comment: One file per environment (lab, customer, ...), shared by all scripts. Copy to config\<name>.config.json (for example lab1.config.json) and run a script with -Environment <name>, or use -ConfigFile <path>. Every script reads the top-level keys, then Common, then its own section; a later one wins. Never put passwords here: use <X>User (the script prompts) or <X>CredentialFile (Get-Credential | Export-Clixml <file>).
